title: Typhoon: What to do
summary: What to do before and during a typhoon: track PAGASA storm signals, secure your home, pack your go-bag, and shelter in place until the official all-clear for your area.
steps: Monitor official PAGASA warnings when connectivity allows and note the latest signal number for your area.
Secure or reinforce the roof, windows, and loose outdoor items.
Prepare your go-bag: water, food, medicines, flashlight, batteries, and copied important documents.
Charge phones and power banks while electricity is still available.
Know your household evacuation route and meeting point.
During the typhoon: stay indoors, away from windows, until the official all-clear for your area.
avoid: Do not step outside to check on anything during heavy winds and rain.
Do not shelter under trees, billboards, or unstable structures.
Do not walk or drive through floodwater of unknown depth.
Do not treat the calm eye as the end of the storm — the strongest winds return from the other direction.
